user.title: Connect to collectd
user.description: Enter the topic prefix used by collectd's mqtt plugin (the `Prefix` option, default `collectd`).

no_data.title: No metrics received
no_data.description: No metric was published below `{prefix}/#` while checking. Make sure collectd is running and publishing with the PLAIN format, or add the integration anyway.

error.invalid_prefix: The topic prefix must not be empty or contain `#`, `+` or spaces.
error.mqtt_not_configured: The MQTT integration is not configured or not available.
error.cannot_connect: Could not subscribe to the MQTT broker.

abort.no_data: No metrics were received, the integration was not added.

init.title: collectd MQTT options
init.description: Filters use glob patterns and are matched against the host name and the `plugin[-plugin_instance]/type[-type_instance]` metric key.

data_description.topic_prefix: Topic prefix used by collectd's mqtt plugin.
data_description.hosts: One glob per line. Empty means every host.
data_description.include: One glob per line. Empty means every metric.
data_description.exclude: One glob per line. Takes precedence over include.
data_description.store_rates: collectd's StoreRates option. Disable it to treat counters as totals.
data_description.stale_after: Seconds without a value before the sensor becomes unavailable.
